continuity_scope: A character-layer pass restricted to Robert Jordan's The Eye of the World, using the Tor Books paperback ISBN 9781250768681. This Book One witness is not a claim about the fourteen-book series, New Spring, companions, graphic novels, television adaptation, or author-transition volumes. Primary claims use chapter number/title locators rather than page numbers from another edition.
coverage_rule: Include the five named Two Rivers travelers; their named individual adult guides and companions; named individual allies who materially join the Eye quest; named individual antagonists who directly drive or attack the party; and the named individual supernatural guardian at the Eye. This 14-individual Book One cohort excludes later-important brief encounters and all collective/group nodes.
omissions: Books 2–14, New Spring, companion/reference works, graphic novels, television adaptation, and all author-transition details.
Named but non-cohort brief or local individuals including Min, Elayne, Morgase, Caemlyn court figures, Taren Ferry figures, Darkfriends, and party-adjacent travelers.

The Two Rivers, Aes Sedai, Warders, the Children of the Light, Trollocs, Myrddraal, Ogier, Forsaken, the One Power, saidin/saidar, the Wheel, Pattern, Eye, horn, ways, prophecies, and places as nodes; they remain terms or dimensions.
Any later-series identity resolution, power development, romance, rank, fate, or outcome beyond what this novel explicitly establishes.
uncertainties: The novel shifts focalization among several travelers and deliberately withholds or misdirects identity and cosmological information. Claims remain at the knowledge state of Book One rather than later revelation.

Edition pagination varies substantially across hardcover, mass-market, anniversary, ebook, and audio releases. Stable chapter numbers/titles are used; physical page claims require the declared printing.
One Power, Aes Sedai, Warder, ta'veren, and Shadow terminology are source-specific; partial comparative language does not make them generic magic classes, factions, or moral-alignment mechanics.
Descriptions are concise paraphrases and major Book One spoilers are labeled; no extended copyrighted prose is reproduced.
evidence_basis: Primary narrative claims are cited to the declared printed novel by chapter number/title. Tor/Macmillan's official product record establishes Book One status, Tor imprint, ISBN, and official synopsis. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, or plot-summary source is used as canonical evidence.
